tooltips.tier-1: Stands for 'physically impossible'. This tier is given to all the published maps which have not been confirmed to be legitimately verified or completed by any player in the game. The rating change should be specifically requested to any staff member of BBDB.
tooltips.tier0: This map does not require any parkour or precision skill at the game, except for basic ability to move the character. This tier is usually given to purely showcase maps with little to no gameplay difficulty involved.
tooltips.tier1: This map requires minimum technical skill to beat, usually involving simple and save, forgiving jumps. There are very few maps of such difficulty, most of which can be compared to the lowest sections of official BETON BRUTAL map at their most difficult segments.
tooltips.tier2: This map requires the most basic skills of BETON BRUTAL to complete, mostly involving simple jumps, without any complex or risky jumpsets or mechanics. Such maps are beatable by most players in the game.
tooltips.tier3: This map requires more skills and time investment to complete, remaining fairly available even to inexperienced players of the game, though still noticeably harder than previous three tiers of difficulty. Comparable to yellow level of BETON BRUTAL map in average.
tooltips.tier4: This map might feel difficult to inexperienced players of the game due to higher skill and precision demand. Such maps require stable control and game physics knowledge to complete, comparable to red level of BETON BRUTAL map.
tooltips.tier5: This map requires significant skill and understanding of all the standard gameplay mechanics of the game to complete. Such maps are often comparable to the difficulty of a whole official BETON BRUTAL map and may require significant time investment to finish, especially for new players.
tooltips.tier6: This map demands advanced skill at the game to complete, involving most of the mechanics of base and BETON BATH DLC maps in their gameplay. These are difficult maps which require a deep understanding of game mechanics and well-developed skill of numerous hours spent.
tooltips.tier7: This map is challenging, requiring highly advanced skill and time investment to complete. In general, such maps may be compared to the most difficult spots of BETON BATH DLC.
tooltips.tier8: This map is highly difficult, usually involving complex mechanics and long chains of dangerous and difficult jumps at most spots. The gameplay of such maps can be compared to the hardest sections of BETON BIRTHDAY official map.
tooltips.tier9: This map classifies as insanely difficult, with gameplay demand being significantly higher than in any of official maps. Such maps are no longer available to most players of the game and may require multiple hours of practicing and attempting to complete.
tooltips.tier10: This map is extremely difficult, accessible to only the best players of BETON BRUTAL. The gameplay requires extreme precision and skill to be able to play through it comfortably. This tier is given to the hardest legitimately verified custom maps at the whole game.
tooltips.tier11: This map is so difficult, that this tier was created specifically to place it into alongside few other such maps. In general, this tier is given to such maps where tier 10 was 'too easy'. Yet, they were still somehow verified. May God be with you.

labels.grapples:
GRAPPLES 
 This map's difficulty is mostly built on complex chains of jumps involving grappling hooks.
labels.wallruns:
WALLRUNS 
 This map's difficulty is mostly derived from complex and difficult chains of a wallrun mechanic.
labels.trampolines:
TRAMPOLINES 
 This map tests the player's skill to use the trampolines effectively at hardest spots.
labels.ice:
ICE 
 This map tests the player's skill to complete difficult segments involving complex mechanics with slippery ice surface.
labels.nerveControl:
NERVE CONTROL 
 This map tests the player's abilities to handle stress on risky and difficult segments.
labels.xxl:
XXL 
 This map has an extreme gameplay length, sometimes requiring up to hours of playtime even on speedrunning pace.
labels.coyotes:
COYOTES 
 This map involves jump segments requiring perfect (coyote-jump) timing to pass.
labels.pfp:
P/F/P 
 This map includes several extremely difficult frame- or pixelperfect jumps to complete.
labels.gimicky:
GIMICKY 
 This map utilizes some experimental, unintuitive gameplay mechanics and might be confusing to learn and beat.
labels.puzzle:
PUZZLE 
 This map is built around quest or puzzle gameplay elements, requiring some task to solve / escape.
labels.moving:
MOVING 
 This map utilizes new dynamic elements and mechanics from the 'moving blocks' update.
labels.showcase:
SHOWCASE 
 This map serves as an experimental visual demonstration of beautiful imagery, rather than a classic gameplay.
labels.overall:
OVERALL 
 This map does not have any specific skillset it tests, instead focusing on complex understanding of all the existing game mechanics.
labels.nonLinear:
NON-LINEAR 
 This map consists of numerous possible, sometimes hidden ways to complete instead of being completely linear.
labels.chockepoints:
CHOKEPOINTS 
 This map features several spots of heavily disbalanced difficulty spikes, with a high risk to fail and lose progress multiple times.
labels.shitpost:
SHITPOST 
 This map was not intended as a serious project, instead of being... complete SHIT to play and often to look at too.
labels.bath:
BATH 
 This map is based on water-related gameplay elements or focuses on BETON BATH type gameplay in its majority.
labels.random:
RANDOM 
 This map has a considerable luck / random factor influence on its gameplay difficulty and completion stability.
labels.precision:
PRECISION 
 This map demands high movement accuracy and controls precision to play and complete effectively.
